title: 新书《我在人间立地成仙》求支持
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
新书《我在人间立地成仙》求支持
新书发布啦，求支持
书名：《我在人间立地成仙》
投胎成为齐王朝国公府的一名世子，方望脑海里有一座天宫，可让意识进入其中修炼，任何功法、绝学都能修炼至大圆满，直至圆满，方才能出来，无论在天宫内待多久，现实都是一瞬间的事。
方望于十六岁时，在无人知晓的情况下踏入武林神话之境。
某日，方望听闻四伯的养女周雪疯了，在国公府内说方府即将被灭门。
方望悄然来到周雪的屋外，正好听到她自言自语：“唉，想我好歹也是一方仙尊，如今回到年少时，却无法扭转家族命运，老天故意捉弄我吗……哪怕是再往前一个月，也不至于如此……”
重生者？
而且还是仙尊？
方望的认知被打破，在震撼的同时还有些惊喜。
能修仙，谁习武啊！
踏遍红尘山河千万里，只寻世间一仙法，能让人立地成仙。

New book released, please support me
Book Title: "I Became an Immortal in the Human World"
Reincarnated as a prince of the Duke of Qi Dynasty, Fang Wang has a heavenly palace in his mind, where his consciousness can enter and practice. Any technique or secret skill can be cultivated to great perfection. Only when it reaches perfection can he come out. No matter how long he stays in the heavenly palace, the reality is only a moment.
At the age of sixteen, Fang Wang entered the realm of martial arts myths without anyone knowing.
One day, Fang Wang heard that Zhou Xue, the adopted daughter of his fourth uncle, was crazy and said in the Duke's Mansion that Fang's family was about to be exterminated.
Fang Wang quietly came outside Zhou Xue's house and happened to hear her talking to herself: "Oh, I guess I am also an immortal. Now that I am back to my youth, I can't change the fate of my family. Is God deliberately playing tricks on me... Even if it was a month ago, it wouldn't be like this..."
Reborn?
And he’s still an Immortal?
Fang Wang's cognition was broken, and he was shocked but also a little surprised.
Who can practice martial arts if he can cultivate immortality?
Traveling thousands of miles across the mountains and rivers of the mortal world, I am only looking for one immortal method in the world that can make people become immortals instantly.
